northStar: Search and AI-agent visits to the site grow beyond the weekly noise band, and every change that caused growth is recorded in a public ledger.
constraint: Cloudflare primitives only. No Google tools or third-party scripts. A person starts every iteration.
falsifiable: A single agent-proposed change, measured against a control group of unchanged pages, moves the target metric by more than the noise band.
unproven: Cloudflare-native data is enough to measure SEO changes without Search Console
Internal cross-links on /prompts/* raise pages per visit and crawler coverage (experiment 001)
openQuestions: Is the noise band on a low-traffic site small enough to detect a single change in 14 days?
Do AI crawler visits respond to the same changes as search crawler visits?
